# 2 Kings 21 — Disagreement Log
**Chapter:** 2 Kings 21 (26 verses)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA
**Total disagreements logged:** 4

---

## V.3 — "high places" vs. "pagan shrines"
- **EMET/LOGOS:** "high places" / **PNEUMA:** "pagan shrines"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "high places" — *bamot* is a technical term that should be preserved consistently.

---

## V.6 — "made his son pass through the fire" vs. "sacrificed his own son"
- **EMET/LOGOS:** "made his son pass through the fire" / **PNEUMA:** "sacrificed his own son in the fire"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "made his son pass through the fire" — the Hebrew euphemism is part of the text's rhetoric.

---

## V.6 — "appointed" vs. "consulted" mediums
- **LOGOS:** "appointed" / **PNEUMA:** "consulted"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "consulted" — captures the functional meaning of *'asah* in this context.

---

## V.23 — "servants" vs. "officials"
- **EMET/LOGOS:** "servants" / **PNEUMA:** "officials"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "servants" — preserves the literal *'avadim*.

---
*— SOPHIA*
